explanation: Requested point W=1.2 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg for eta electroproduction (e p -> e' p eta) is below the reaction threshold W_thr = 1.4861 GeV: there is insufficient invariant mass to produce a proton plus an eta meson (m_eta = 547.86 MeV). This is confirmed independently by the EXCLURAD preflight check (w_threshold: FAIL) and by the MAID/EtaMAID-2023 multipole lookup table itself, whose W-grid only starts at 1.4856 GeV (table_coverage: FAIL). This is a physical impossibility, not a formatting or numerical issue, so no input file was generated -- attempting to run EXCLURAD at this point risks either an infinite hang in the integrator or a silent N/A exit with no 'tai:' line, per known quirks of this channel. To proceed, request W >= ~1.4961 GeV (a valid grid point within table coverage) for the eta channel, or switch to a channel whose threshold covers W=1.2 GeV (e.g. e p -> e' n pi+, threshold 1.0791 GeV).
